state.conditionalProtocol: Only valid_as_defined passes. If initial valid API response verdict is non-pass or indeterminate, preserve the exact initial decision summary and probability distribution, construct at least two mutually exclusive case-specific immediate actions each targeting exactly one of code, plan, OpenSpec, or evidence-only and carrying the same finding/location/evidence or neededEvidence; call one follow-up only. Require choice ID, case finding, affected requirement/path, evidence or exact neededEvidence, concrete action/fix, remainingUncertainty (explicit none if none); effectiveVerdict=require_revalidation. Incomplete diagnostic detail => resolution=unresolved, diagnosisStatus=incomplete, unresolvedReasons. No chaining. Initial valid verdict gets no follow-up. Transport/schema errors get no follow-up and remain errors.

criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete failure exists in Browser Mode replacement, removed Playwright contract, source, or updated ownership record.
